decisions.decision: Galaxy Lessons are trivial — build in class tomorrow morning. Do not pad time estimates for simple tasks.
Canon audit must be automated — the bi-hourly pulse owns this, not manual chat. If the pulse can't do it, the pulse is broken.
Lead with one real move — don't present filler options. If there's only one real option, say so.
Agent must self-manage permissions — Michael should not have to manually upgrade edit access.
DONT ASK JUST DO — reinforced as standing law for all sessions.
